A good first layer is flat, even lines. Curling, dragging or blobs: press Stop.
Write your print on the print board: printer, your name, start time.
Wait until the plate is cool, then flex it and the part pops off.
The rig: the top hole sits on a fixed pin, a rope through the bowl pulls down until the hook breaks. Copy the breaking load from the score sheet.
It snapped: a clean break across the part, two pieces.
It pulled open: the bowl bent out until it stopped holding.
It delaminated: the printed layers split apart from each other.
The joint let go: the pieces of a multi-part hook pulled apart.
